message.content: On February 24, 1815, Edmond Dantès, the young and capable first mate of the *Pharaon*, returns to Marseilles with news of Captain Leclère’s death and reveals he fulfilled the captain’s dying wish by delivering a packet to Marshal Bertrand at Elba—where he also spoke with the exiled Emperor Napoleon—while the envious supercargo Danglars seeds doubt in the shipowner Morrel’s mind about Dantès’s conduct and loyalty, foreshadowing the conspiracy to come.
